en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: eik kavaau pasaau kar oa(n)kaar anek akaaraa|

en.bdb: By one bang, the Oankar created and spread myriad of forms.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਗਾਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਵਿਥਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: paun paanee baisa(n)taro dharat agaas nivaas vithaaraa|

en.bdb: He extended His self in the form of air, water, fire, earth and sky etc.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਤਰਵਰ ਪਰਬਤਾਂ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਅਗਣਤ ਅਪਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: jal thal taravar parabataa(n) jeea ja(n)t aganat apaaraa|

en.bdb: He created water, land, trees, mountains and many biotic communities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਵਰਭੰਡੁ ਅਖੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਲਖ ਵਰਭੰਡ ਪਲਕ ਪਲਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: eik varabha(n)dd akha(n)dd hai lakh varabha(n)dd palak palakaaraa|

en.bdb: That supreme creator Himself is indivisible and in one wink of an eye can create millions of universes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kudharat keem na jaaneeaai kevadd kaadhar sirajanahaaraa|

en.bdb: When boundaries of His creation are unknowable, how can the expanse of that Creator be known?
No end is there of His extremes; they are infinite.
